req.title: Login case-sensitive username
req.statement: The system shall treat usernames as case-sensitive on POST /auth/login.

doc.reasoning: The violation is that test[4] has kind='negative' but heuristic='STC'. STC (State Transition Coverage) is not valid for a negative test under the rule-based verifier. To fix this, I change test[4]'s heuristic from 'STC' to 'NEG', which is the correct heuristic for a negative test verifying that wrong-case credentials produce no session. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_login_exact_case_username_succeeds():
    fd2, path2 = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd2)
    app2 = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path2})
    with app2.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client2 = app2.test_client()
    r2 = client2.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r2.status_code == 302
    assert r2.headers['Location'] == '/'
    os.unlink(path2)

test_login_exact_case_username_succeeds()

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_login_wrong_case_username_fails():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
    assert b'Incorrect username.' in r.data, 'Expected Incorrect username. error'
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' not in sess, 'Session should not contain user_id'
    os.unlink(path)

test_login_wrong_case_username_fails()

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_login_case_variants_all_rejected_except_exact():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    wrong_cases = ['RAHUL', 'rahul', 'rAHUL']
    for variant in wrong_cases:
        r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': variant, 'password': 'stone'})
        assert r.status_code == 200, f'Variant {variant!r}: expected 200, got {r.status_code}'
        assert b'Incorrect username.' in r.data, f'Variant {variant!r}: expected Incorrect username. error'
    r_ok = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r_ok.status_code == 302, f'Exact case: expected 302, got {r_ok.status_code}'
    assert r_ok.headers['Location'] == '/'
    os.unlink(path)

test_login_case_variants_all_rejected_except_exact()

    client = app.test_client()
    r1 = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'anjali', 'password': 'cloud'})
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert b'Incorrect username.' in r1.data

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_login_case_sensitive_no_session_on_wrong_case():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r_wrong = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'ishaan', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r_wrong.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r_wrong.status_code}'
    assert b'Incorrect username.' in r_wrong.data, 'Expected Incorrect username. error'
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' not in sess, 'Session must not contain user_id after wrong-case attempt'
    r_ok = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r_ok.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302, got {r_ok.status_code}'
    assert r_ok.headers['Location'] == '/'
    with client.session_transaction() as sess2:
        assert 'user_id' in sess2, 'Session must contain user_id after exact-case login'
    os.unlink(path)

test_login_case_sensitive_no_session_on_wrong_case()
